About

Simple, helpful websites—with room to grow.

I enjoy creating web experiences that help people find information and help small businesses present their services online. I use coding tools and AI assistance as part of my learning process, and I test and improve my work as I go.

My current portfolio includes Guimaras DineBook, a restaurant reservation and booking-management project, plus two class-fund tools I built for our own section's collection records. I'm building experience with responsive layouts, interactive forms, and database-connected features.

How I work

A clear process from idea to handover.

STEP 01

Understand

Discuss your business, audience, goals, budget, and required pages.

STEP 02

Plan

Agree on the features, timeline, price, content, and what is not included.

STEP 03

Build & test

Create the agreed design, test it on different screens, and fix issues.

STEP 04

Handover

Share the finished work and explain any hosting, access, and maintenance needs.
